content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Atlanta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verified project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and work-hour thresholds for the PMP credential. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you document your background and confirm you meet all entry requirements before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, learning project-management frameworks and exam domains directly from active certified practitioners. Your 35 contact hours satisfy PMI's formal-education prerequisite and prepare you for the certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, apply directly to PMI and pay the examination fee. Submit your education and experience documentation for PMI's review. Once approved, you'll receive authorization to sit for the PMP exam within the timeframe PMI specifies.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Complete the proctored exam, which tests your mastery of project-management knowledge and decision-making.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Complete continuing education through PMI-approved courses, conferences, volunteer work, or on-the-job project leadership. Renew your credential before expiration to remain recognized by employers across Atlanta's competitive job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
